source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 6 ("Four contests in Fermanagh local government elections")

source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Irvinestown rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There were no contests, but six changes of personnel, five Unionist and one Anti-Partitionist. The Fermanagh Herald prints the nominations. Anti-Partitionist. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Lattoone' to Lattone (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Lattone; the rounds were filed as Lattone (1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1955, 1961, 1964); Lattoon (1949); Lattoone (1952). This round was filed as 'Lattoone', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (lattoone) answers with a redirect to this one.
